## 本页定位：版本总览，不做下载主入口

如果你要找“遗忘之海下载、官网下载、移动端安装”，请先看 [遗忘之海下载主入口](/zh/sea/download)。本页主要整理 PC 公测、移动端上线、首月版本内容、gamescom demo、福利和后续更新节点。

## 首发时间与平台

《遗忘之海》现在已经进入两个已发生节点：**2026 年 7 月 9 日 PC 公测**，以及 **2026 年 7 月 23 日移动端首发**。现在重点已经从“预热等待”切到“入口、账号、设备、首日排错和首月运营”。

同时，官方/发行侧围绕 **gamescom 2026 可试玩 demo** 做外部曝光，这会继续放大英文搜索里的 demo、review、gameplay、Steam、PS5/Xbox 和平台确认类问题。可以把它理解为海外关注信号，但不要当成主机版日期确认。

## 当前重点内容

| 模块 | 当前信息 | Gachia 跟进 |
|------|---------|-----------|
| 平台 | PC 已上线，移动端 7 月 23 日首发 | 移动端 FAQ、平台入口、首日排错 |
| 全球曝光 | gamescom 2026 demo 信号增强 | review / gameplay / PS5/Xbox FAQ |
| 海域 | 白沙海、渡桥海首批开放，隐秘海待官方后续公布 | 海区攻略、材料点与 BOSS 坐标页 |
| 船员 | 首月 20+ 船员，茉莉限时 UP，黑格为赛季船员 | 获取方式、UP 状态、所属船队 |
| 系统 | 记忆重逢、记忆共鸣、噩梦深潜、大漩涡、交易行 | 机制指南与收益规划 |
| 福利 | 公测 100 抽、新手 40 抽黑券保底、版本兑换码 | 兑换码页每日巡检 |

## 今日建议先看

1. 移动端首发 FAQ：解决 iOS / Android、互通、配置和今天先玩哪端。
2. 平台入口速查：把 Steam、官方启动器、iOS、Android 和云试玩分开。
3. 首周运营总览：把热修、号角、大脸币、查漏和首日排错串起来。
4. PS5 / Xbox / Review / Gameplay FAQ：查看 gamescom demo 后的英文平台和评价相关问题。

## 数据状态

本文已切换为 **2026-07-23 移动端首发日口径**。账号互通、奖励领取、平台礼包、热修和后续海域开放仍以官网、平台商店、游戏内公告和官方社区为准。
contentEn:
## Launch Timing and Platforms

Sea of Remnants now has two live milestones: **July 9, 2026 PC open beta** and **July 23, 2026 mobile launch**. The site should move from pre-launch waiting language into entry, account, device, troubleshooting, and month-one live-ops routing.

Official/publisher channels are also promoting a **gamescom 2026 playable demo**. Treat this as a global discovery signal for demo, review, gameplay, Steam, PS5/Xbox, and platform-confirmation searches, but not as a confirmed console release date.

## Current Highlights

| add-onule | Current info | Gachia follow-up |
|------|---------|-----------|
| Platforms | PC live; mobile launch on July 23 | Mobile FAQ, platform entry, first-day troubleshooting |
| Global exposure | gamescom 2026 demo signal | Review / gameplay / PS5/Xbox FAQ |
| Regions | White Sand Sea and Bridge Sea live; Hidden Sea pending official confirmation | Region guides, material points, boss coordinates |
| Crews | 20+ launch-month crews, Molly limited UP, Heige as season crew | Obtain method, UP status, fleet tags |
| Systems | Memory Reunion, Memory Resonance, Nightmare Dive, Maelstrom, trade market | System guides and reward planning |
| Rewards | 100 launch pulls, beginner 40-pull Black Ticket guarantee, version codes | Daily code checks |

## Page Priority Today

1. Mobile launch FAQ: iOS/Android, cross-progress, specs, and platform choice.
2. Platform entry guide: Steam, official launcher, iOS, Android, and cloud trial.
3. Week-one live-ops hub: hotfixes, Horns, Face Coins, collection gaps, and first-day issues.
4. PS5 / Xbox / Review / Gameplay FAQ: English platform and review searches after gamescom demo buzz.

## Data Status

This page now uses **July 23, 2026 mobile launch-day wording**. Account linking, rewards, platform gifts, hotfixes, and future region openings still depend on official site, store, in-game, and community notices.
